name: Jackfruit Rogan Josh
ingredients: 300 g young jackfruit in brine, drained, rinsed and pieces squeezed dry
50 g dry soy chunks, soaked and squeezed
¼ cup plain unsweetened soy yogurt
1 bay leaf, 2 cardamom pods, 2 cloves, 1 small cinnamon stick
1 tsp fennel powder and ½ tsp dry ginger powder
steps: Heat the oil and crackle the whole spices. Add the onion and cook for 8 minutes until deep golden.
Add the tomato purée, chilli, fennel and ginger powder and cook for 8 minutes until the oil separates.
Add the jackfruit and soy chunks and stir for 4 minutes.
Stir in the soy yogurt and 1 cup water; cover and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and finish with coriander.
note: Jackfruit gives a meaty texture; the soy chunks lift the protein to a main-meal level.
